subject: Marine Works - Pointe à Michel to Pointe-des-Monts - Baie-Comeau Port
text:
Marine Works - Pointe à Michel to Pointe-des-Monts - Baie-Comeau Port
Dredging operations taking place daily during daylight hours at the Baie-Comeau DFO dock beginning at 031100 Nov 2026. Dredge, barges and tugs on site.
Minimum wake requested.
